Deep in the forests of Washington’s Olympic Peninsula is a world most Americans know little about. This was once some of the richest logging country in the world, with booming towns like Aberdeen built around the industry. But times have changed, and many of these communities are struggling to find their footing. Join me as we meet up with a local logger, head deep into the woods, hear some wild local folklore, explore clear-cuts, and get an inside look at the culture and way of life in this fascinating corner of America.

► 🎥
title: Inside America's Forgotten Timber Country
